title: Notice under Section 61 for intimating discrepancies in the return (Form GST ASMT-10)

findings.text: You are hereby directed to explain the discrepancies and pay the tax of Rs. 4,52,300 with interest within 30 days of receipt of this notice.

findings.text: A personal hearing is fixed on 18 November 2026 at 11:00 AM before the undersigned at the Division office.

findings.text: Failure to reply will attract proceedings under Section 73(1) of the Act, including a penalty of Rs. 2.5 lakh, without further notice.
